0.long_answer: The gene in question, RPS19, encodes the ribosomal protein S19 which interacts with basic fibroblast growth factor. Mutations in RPS19 are known to cause Diamond-Blackfan anemia (DBA). According to the provided information, studies have identified ten novel mutations in the RPS19 gene that are linked to DBA. These mutations are distinct and contribute to the pathology of the disease by impairing ribosome biogenesis and affecting erythropoietic differentiation.
